exact_statement: For every finite disjoint tensor product of Boolean one-point defects f_m=1-2*1_point, m>=2, including physical translations, global sign, character multiplication, fresh character coordinates and irrelevant coordinates, let P=fhat^2, Q be the product of its actual spectral coordinate marginals, B=sum_i h2(P(i in S)), K=D2(P||Q), b=sign(fhat)*sqrt(Q) on the common support and zero off it, v_U=(sum_S b_S b_{S xor U})^2, Z=sum_U v_U, T=H(v/Z)-log2 Z, I=sum_i P(i in S). Then K>=max(0,B-4I), K>=T/4-8I, and B<=T/4+8I. In particular the latter two separately proved inequalities imply H(P)<=16I, while the direct factor entropy bound gives H(P)<=4I. All entropy and divergence quantities are in bits.
